keywords.primary: contractor destroys work after not getting paid

instagram.caption:
She held back $4,225 on a shower rebuild. So the contractor came back with a sledgehammer.
A homeowner in Colorado had paid $3,330 of a $7,555 bill. She says she wasn't happy with the work and wanted to check it before paying the rest.
The contractor took a sledgehammer to the shower he had built, and his company called it repossessing the shower. What the court did is at the end of the video.
Small claims court in Colorado takes cases up to $7,500. His $4,225 fit.
She held back the last payment. He came back with a sledgehammer. Who was more wrong?
Send this to someone who'd take it back.
Source: KRDO 13 (reports from Sept 2021 to Oct 2022), CBS Colorado, Levelset, Colorado Judicial Branch. Two short lines in the video are reenactments in our own words.
